text: Skip to main content How to Use the Tax Return Preparer Directory - YouTube video text script More In News Working Families Tax Cuts News releases Tax relief in disaster situations Topics in the news Fact sheets IRS statements and announcements IRS Tax Tips IRS guidance Multimedia center Social media American Sign Language (ASL) Radio PSAs Tax articles to share Posters to share HI… I'M ALEXIS. AND I WORK FOR THE INTERNAL REVENUE SERVICE. THE I-R-S ENCOURAGES YOU TO CHOOSE YOUR TAX RETURN PREPARER CAREFULLY… AND WE HAVE A TOOL TO HELP YOU MAKE YOUR CHOICE. THE I-R-S TOOL ALLOWS YOU TO LOOK UP TAX RETURN PREPARERS WITH CREDENTIALS OR QUALIFICATIONS THAT NOT ALL TAX RETURN PREPARERS HAVE. GO TO I-R-S-DOT-GOV-SLASH-CHOOSE-A-TAX-PRO TO FIND THE SEARCHABLE DIRECTORY. CLICK "DIRECTORY OF FEDERAL TAX RETURN PREPARERS WITH CREDENTIALS AND SELECT QUALIFICATIONS." THE DIRECTORY CONTAINS THOSE TAX RETURN PREPARERS WHO HAVE ONE OR MORE OF THE FOLLOWING CREDENTIALS… ATTORNEY… CERTIFIED PUBLIC ACCOUNTANT… ENROLLED AGENT… ENROLLED RETIREMENT PLAN AGENT… OR ENROLLED ACTUARY. THE DIRECTORY ALSO CONTAINS TAX RETURN PREPARERS WHO DON'T HAVE ANYOF THESE PROFESSIONAL CREDENTIALS BUT WHO HAVE ELECTED TO VOLUNTARILY TAKE SUFFICIENT CONTINUING EDUCATION COURSES TO RECEIVE AN I-R-S ANNUAL FILING SEASON PROGRAM RECORD OF COMPLETION. YOU CAN SEARCH THE DIRECTORY BY ZIP CODE… LAST NAME… OR BY A SPECIFIC CREDENTIAL OR QUALIFICATION. THE SEARCH RESULTS PROVIDE THE NAME… CITY… STATE… ZIP CODE… AND CREDENTIALS OR QUALIFICATIONS OF THE TAX RETURN PREPARERS WHO MEET YOUR DESIRED CRITERIA. YOU CAN SORT THE SEARCH RESULTS BY ANY OF THE CATEGORIES. IF YOU GO TO THE "MORE INFORMATION" SECTION… YOU CAN ALSO VIEW DESCRIPTIONS OF THESE PROFESSIONAL DESIGNATIONS AND LEARN ABOUT THE DIFFERENCES. FOR MORE INFORMATION… GO TO I-R-S-DOT-GOV-SLASH-CHOOSE-A-TAX-PRO. Page Last Reviewed or Updated: 05-Dec-2025 Share Facebook Twitter Linkedin Print
